from services.models import Service, ProviderConfig, TranslatorConfig, OptimizerConfig
from services.config_loader import load_provider_configs, load_translator_configs, load_optimizer_configs

providers = load_provider_configs\(base_dir=base\)
translators = load_translator_configs\(base_dir=base\)
optimizers = load_optimizer_configs\(base_dir=base\)

print\('Providers:'\)
for p in providers:
    print\(f'  {p.service.name}: active={p.service.active}, generate keys={list\(p.service.config.get\(\\"generate\\", {}\).keys\(\)\)[:3]}'\)

print\('Translators:'\)
for t in translators:
    print\(f'  {t.service.name}: active={t.service.active}, priority={t.service.priority}'\)

print\('Optimizers:'\)
for o in optimizers:
    print\(f'  {o.service.name}: active={o.service.active}, config={o.service.config}'\)
